subject.title: [Feature]: Add read-only sessions diagnose command for stuck-session triage

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the linked additive `sessions.diagnose` Gateway and CLI diagnostic contract as a supported core operator surface?
rationale: The linked PR is technically scoped and proof-backed, but it introduces a new public Gateway and CLI API whose long-term diagnostic vocabulary and support boundary require maintainer product acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor the diagnostic contract
options.body: Review and merge the linked pull request if maintainers accept its read-only session-diagnosis API as a supported core surface.

options.title: Narrow or defer the surface
options.body: Ask for a reduced contract or close the implementation PR if the proposed diagnostic capability should remain outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the diagnostic contract
recommendation.body: Review and merge the linked pull request if maintainers accept its read-only session-diagnosis API as a supported core surface.

likelyOwner.reason: A responsible individual owner could not be established without the required local history pass; existing maintainer review on the linked PR is the safest routing path.
